Name: Achish, Son of Maoch
Summary: Achish, son of Maoch and king of Gath, twice sheltered David. David feigned madness before him to escape, and later lived under his protection at Ziklag, raiding Israel's enemies while Achish believed he fought for Philistia.
KeyStory: Achish sheltered the very man destined to defeat his people, fooled twice by David's acting.
LifeLesson: God can hide his anointed in the enemy's own city when the time is not yet ripe.
